# nah_policy_binding (Resource)

Manages a NahCloud policy_binding.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nah_policy_binding" "automation" {
  policy_id      = nah_policy.read_network.id
  principal_type = "api_key"
  principal_id   = nah_api_key.automation.id
  target_type    = "project"
  target_id      = nah_project.app.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `policy_id` (String) Opaque parent policy ID.
- `principal_id` (String) Opaque principal ID.
- `principal_type` (String) Immutable principal type.
- `target_id` (String) Opaque target ID.
- `target_type` (String) Immutable target type.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Opaque binding ID.
- `org_id` (String) Opaque authenticated organization ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import nah_policy_binding.automation POLICY_ID/BINDING_ID
```
